subject: a runner made from one thick elastic loop
pose: leaning forward mid-stride with the loop compressed
requested_medium: matte elastic sculpture with graphic lighting
art_direction: 一条青色弹性环扭成跑步角色，橙色鞋片和大幅前倾姿势形成鲜明动势，中心轮廓紧凑。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Shape one thick turquoise elastic loop into a compact running character, with its upper bend acting as the head and its lower folds becoming two legs. Add small orange shoe plates but no separate human anatomy. A single dark inset eye on the head bend gives it focused eagerness. Compress one side of the loop and stretch the other to make the material tension visible. Use matte surfaces, a few tight specular edges, and a warm cream background. The pose leans forward in a captured stride, yet all limbs curl inward enough to fit a circular avatar crop. Avoid motion streak clutter; the deformation itself supplies the sense of speed.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
